His amber eye is open, cold and alert. A single thin blade of moon-blue light cuts across the eye; everything else falls to black. Keep the composition.
shots.video: Extreme macro close-up. The strawberry man's amber eye slowly opens, cold and alert. Ash drifts through a single blade of moonlight. Each distant heavy thud makes soil grains jump and the frame tremble slightly. Very slow push-in. Dark, tense, cinematic, animated feature film.

shots.image: Re-render this frame as {style} Extreme wide long-lens shot across a scorched black plain at night. Strictly backlit by distant fires, ember-orange rim light only, faces always in total black shadow. Keep the composition.
shots.video: The silhouetted boar and bull warriors march forward in unison through rolling smoke, ember rim light on tusks and horns, braziers trailing sparks, breath steaming. Faces stay in black shadow. Locked camera shudders with each heavy footfall. Ominous, serious, cinematic animated feature film.

shots.image: Re-render this frame as {style} Massive timber-and-iron orchard gate swung open at sunrise, golden light pouring through, revealing hundreds of anthropomorphic fruit and vegetable warriors standing together in ranks: towering celery with pikes, armored pineapples with shields, tiny blueberries in red bandanas, onions with tears loading crossbows, apples, peppers, plums. shots.video: The giant gate doors finish swinging open toward camera as golden dawn light floods in, revealing the vast produce army standing together. Banners stir, pollen glows in god rays. Slow crane up and back. Epic, hopeful and frightening, cinematic animated feature film.

shots.video: The strawberry hero walks toward camera down the center of the army as the camera pushes in to a close-up; he stops and says quietly, with quiet fury, 'So stay angry.'
